name: Quick Pill 5.6.0
changelog: Feature: Glassmorphism effect & Windows wallpaper adaptive dynamic coloring (Settings > Appearance).
Feature: Synced lyrics via lrclib with multi-tier exact & fuzzy searching, auto-scrolling, plain text fallback, and click-to-seek.
Fix: Resolved lyrics out-of-sync and unloading issue by eliminating position timer race conditions on zero position.
Optimization: Ponytail code audit cleanup - removed unused dependencies (node-powershell, react-markdown) cutting 90 subpackages.
Optimization: Cleaned 30 unused Lucide icon imports and eliminated shadowed duplicate relative time functions.
CI/CD: Automated GitHub Actions release pipeline for both Electron and Tauri installers.
